svg.title: VisionIQ 09 - PR-driven learning
svg.text: PR-Driven Learning — When the Knowledge Base Changes
Every PR event adds evidence immediately. Reusable lessons change only when new verified or disputed evidence exists.
• PR ID, source and target SHAs
Live: after hackathon · Demo: replayed history
• No global retraining on each PR: incremental event ingestion, selective reindex of affected files and chunks, verified lesson consolidation.
• Replaying the same event twice changes nothing. Repeated tickets link to one pattern instead of creating duplicate lessons.
• OKF Markdown/YAML is an optional curated export of approved lessons — not the database, the graph or the search engine.
